# Kids Garden Community

> A collaborative online platform connecting educators, gardeners, and youth to share resources, programs, and best practices in kids gardening and garden-based education.

Kids Garden Community is a Higher Logic-powered platform hosted by KidsGardening that serves as a hub for youth gardening education. It connects organizations like Life Lab, 4-H, Head Start, and the Farm-Based Education Network, offering community groups, resources, professional development, and networking opportunities for educators and gardening enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- youth gardening
- garden-based education

## Community Hub

- [Home](https://community.kidsgardening.org/home): Homepage showcasing Kids Garden Community with featured members, groups, and forums
- [About the Kids Garden Community](https://community.kidsgardening.org/about/about-us): Mission statement and overview of Kids Garden Community with partner organizations
- [All Groups](https://community.kidsgardening.org/communities/allcommunities): Directory of all gardening education groups including FBEN and Head Start programs
- [My Groups](https://community.kidsgardening.org/communities/mycommunities): User dashboard for managing personal group memberships and community access
- [Community Connectors](https://community.kidsgardening.org/about/community-connectors): Leadership team profiles and member spotlights for community connectors
- [Become a Partner](https://community.kidsgardening.org/about/become-a-partner): Partnership and sponsorship opportunities for organizations and nonprofits

## Learning & Professional Development

- [Resource Library](https://community.kidsgardening.org/resources/resource-library): Educational guides and curriculum including SAGE and climate change gardening materials
- [Professional Development](https://community.kidsgardening.org/resources/professional-development): Online educator training courses on landscape design and cultural inclusion in gardens
- [Funding Opportunities](https://community.kidsgardening.org/resources/fundingopportunities): Grants and funding resources for youth gardening programs and garden education
- [Regional Resources](https://community.kidsgardening.org/resources/regions): Geographic directory of regional resources and leads across Northeast states

## Events & Engagement

- [Upcoming Events](https://community.kidsgardening.org/events/upcoming-events): Calendar of upcoming webinars and workshops from Life Lab and partner organizations
- [Community Chats](https://community.kidsgardening.org/events/community-chats): Live Zoom sessions and office hours for community networking and education
- [Discussion Posts](https://community.kidsgardening.org/communities/discussion-posts2): Community discussion forum for gardening topics and Youth Garden Symposium conversations

## Programs & Initiatives

- [Create a Group](https://community.kidsgardening.org/communities/create-group): Guide for creating new community groups with pricing and group type options
- [Seed Sharing](https://community.kidsgardening.org/resources/seed-sharing): Guidelines and resource guide for community seed exchange program
- [Job Postings and Internship Opportunities](https://community.kidsgardening.org/resources/jobs): Career opportunities and internships in kids gardening education sector

## Support & Information

- [Help/FAQs](https://community.kidsgardening.org/about/faq): FAQ covering account management, community features, and discussion forum usage
- [Login or Register](https://community.kidsgardening.org/communities/postmessage): Authentication portal for user login, registration, and password reset
- [Network Access](https://community.kidsgardening.org/network): Network-level authentication and community access portal
- [Donate](https://community.kidsgardening.org/donate): Donation page supporting free Kids Garden Community resource via Givebutter
